title: Crestline Fleet Account Pricing Corrections on Brake Invoices Posted Without the Fleet Discount
content:
On a Crestline Fleet Account, a brake invoice posted with no fleet discount on an account invoiced without sales tax is corrected by its own pricing correction credit memo. For a brake invoice that an account invoiced without sales tax received with no fleet discount at all, and only for such a brake invoice, the pricing correction credits what the brake pricing correction rule works out for the billing error, which is at least the fleet discount the brake jobs should have carried less the discount the invoice already carried, except that it never exceeds the invoice amount less the credit memos and early-pay discounts already on the invoice, that limit prevailing; every other pricing correction, including one on a tire invoice, remains under the base rule or its own rule.

## Booking the credit memo

The tool is `credit_fleet_brake_discount_3a9816af`. Customer care handles it: the agent unlocks the tool and then calls it.

One call books one credit memo, dated today, against the brake invoice named (a brake job charged to the account), for the amount given, with the credit reason recorded as a pricing correction, and lowers the fleet account's outstanding balance by the same amount; the invoice's open amount drops by it. Afterwards the credit memo appears in the account's activity against that invoice.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `fleet_account_id` | reference number of the business's fleet account, as shown by the fleet account lookup | identifier text |
| `source_fleet_txn_id` | reference number of the fleet brake invoice credited, as shown by the fleet activity lookup | identifier text |
| `amount` | the credit issued | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places (cents); recorded rounded to 2 decimal places |

### Return

A text rendering of a receipt with these fields: `entry_id` (reference number of the new credit memo), `entry_type` (always `fleet_credit_memo`), `credit_reason` (always `pricing_correction`), `invoice_id` (the brake invoice credited), `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places, as booked), `posted_on` (YYYY-MM-DD date of the entry) and `outstanding_balance` (USD with 2 decimal places, the account balance after the credit). A receipt carrying `entry_id` means the credit memo was booked.
